description: Small native design-knowledge index for targeted lookup, not a claim of full UI UX Pro Max parity or WCAG certification.

records.title: Operational dashboard hierarchy
records.guidance: Start from the primary operational decision and most frequent task. Keep status, active filters, error recovery and row actions legible; do not turn every datum into an ornamental card.
checks: Users can find primary action and current system state without guessing
Filter/sort and row actions remain keyboard-accessible
Data density matches operational frequency

records.title: Persuasive landing-page structure
records.guidance: Lead with a specific audience/job and believable promise. Show concrete proof before elaborate decoration, and give the primary CTA a clear consequence.
checks: Hero explains for whom and why, using factual claims
Primary and secondary actions are distinguished
Proof does not invent testimonials or metrics

records.title: Readable long-form surfaces
records.guidance: Use a stable reading column, clear heading structure and calm type scale. Support long words, code samples and narrow screens without horizontal overflow.
checks: Heading levels reflect document hierarchy
Long content and code can scroll without clipping critical text
Line length and spacing support reading

records.title: Immersive experience feedback
records.guidance: Define interaction feedback and performance budgets before visual effects. Reduced-motion and non-visual alternatives must preserve critical state information.
checks: Action feedback is immediate and perceivable
No essential information exists only in motion
Interaction runs within target device budget

records.title: Visible keyboard focus and logical order
records.guidance: Every keyboard-reachable interactive element needs a visible focus indicator. Preserve logical focus order, modal focus containment and escape/return behavior.
checks: Focus indicator is visible against adjacent colors
Tab order reflects visual/semantic order
Dialog restores focus to initiating control

records.title: Text and component contrast
records.guidance: Calculate WCAG relative luminance and contrast for actual text and backgrounds. Typical WCAG AA targets are 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for large text; verify current standards for non-text components.
checks: Measured text contrast meets selected compliance goal
States remain perceivable without color alone
Disabled and hover states do not hide critical information

records.title: Touch and pointer target boundaries
records.guidance: Design comfortably tappable controls; check WCAG 2.2 minimum 24x24 CSS px or applicable spacing exceptions, while platform guidelines often recommend larger targets such as 44x44 for touch comfort.
checks: Target dimensions and spacing are measured
Dense toolbars remain navigable on narrow screens
User overrides do not break functional minimums

records.title: Error, loading and empty states
records.guidance: Model loading, empty, partial failure, permission denial and recovery. State messages should name what happened and the next safe user action; announce essential asynchronous changes accessibly.
checks: Critical errors have a recovery path
Loading does not block keyboard navigation silently
Status information is not only color or icon

records.title: Compositor-friendly animation
records.guidance: Prefer opacity and transform animation for non-layout effects. Avoid broad transition: all and per-frame top/left/width mutations; respect reduced-motion and measure on target hardware.
checks: No repeated layout thrash under animation
prefers-reduced-motion preserves state
No arbitrary animation for routine state changes

records.title: Design token layers
records.guidance: Separate primitive/reference tokens from semantic/system roles and component slots. Components reference semantic roles rather than hard-coding one-off colors.
checks: Token relationships support dark/light or product themes
Contrast checked for every semantic foreground/background pair
No ungoverned duplicate colors drift across screens

records.title: Next.js client/server boundaries
records.guidance: Keep noninteractive data/UI on server boundaries when practical. Place 'use client' at minimal interactive leaf boundaries, avoid shipping secrets, and align hydration with real states.
checks: No browser API executes server-side
Client components do not import server-only secrets
Async data states and suspense boundaries are user-legible

records.title: React animation lifecycle
records.guidance: Own animation instances within component lifecycle, revert effects on unmount, and keep SSR/hydration paths stable. Use existing animation stack before introducing a dependency.
checks: No animation remains after unmount
Reduced-motion option is present
Dependency and bundle cost justified

records.title: Tailwind and component-system consistency
records.guidance: Use component primitives and shared semantic design tokens consistently. Do not style every component with ad hoc utility combinations that undermine visual hierarchy and maintainability.
checks: Focus and disabled states covered
Responsive combinations do not overflow
Shared components respect semantic tokens

records.title: Responsive information density
records.guidance: Adapt information hierarchy, not merely width. Decide which fields/actions remain visible, move secondary controls to discoverable menus only if usable, and test short viewports.
checks: No horizontal clipping of essential actions
No CTA hidden under fixed bottom regions
Long labels and localized copy wrap correctly

records.title: Form guidance and validation
records.guidance: Explain required information, validation timing, privacy and submit outcome. Preserve values after recoverable errors; do not use decorative controls with inert handlers.
checks: Every field has accessible label/help/error association
Submit button state is actionable and truthful
Keyboard submission and error focus are verified

records.title: Data visualization evidence and labeling
records.guidance: Define unit, aggregation grain, comparison period and source before plotting. Avoid invented KPIs, deceptive axes and color-only categories; prioritize the action the chart enables.
checks: Every displayed number has source/period/unit
Axes and missing data are clearly labeled
No qualitative 'up/down' claim without comparison context

records.title: Brief-first critique and polish
records.guidance: First evaluate against the user's explicit brief and required workflows; then inspect visual hierarchy, alignment, rhythm, interaction consistency, accessibility, copy and novelty. Recommend targeted refinements, not unrequested redesign.
checks: Each critique points to a visible defect and desired outcome
Intentional user style overrides respected
Before/after changes measured on actual rendered surface

records.title: Baseline UI floor
records.guidance: Apply non-negotiable functional floor: focus indication, reduced motion, bounded overflow, working controls, legible state and no avoidable layout jank. Record scoped waivers and why they do not harm core use.
checks: No transition: all on complex layout changes
Keyboard focus remains visible
Short/narrow viewport states remain usable

records.title: Intent-aware anti-slop
records.guidance: Flag repeated purposeless cards, ornamental badges, fake metrics and generic slogans when they harm hierarchy. Do not categorically prohibit gradients, pills or expressive brands requested by the user.
checks: Critique identifies harm and alternative
Brand direction preserved where intentional
No unsupported marketing claim
